ios.desc:
Know if today is a hard day before you get out of bed.

Atlas turns the data your Apple Watch already collects into one readiness score, waiting for you each morning. It is built on your own HRV baseline, not a generic 0-to-100 scale.

No chest strap. No second wearable. No manual logging.

WHY ATLAS IS DIFFERENT

Most recovery apps want you to buy their hardware. Atlas reads the Apple Watch already on your wrist, and scores you against your own normal instead of a population average.

YOUR MORNING READINESS SCORE
Atlas syncs overnight and calculates your readiness before you wake up. See whether today is a day to go hard or dial it back, plus the specific factors that moved the number.

TRAINING BALANCE THAT RESPECTS FATIGUE
Fitness, fatigue, and form, tracked as three separate signals. Know whether you are loading, holding steady, or overreaching before the next session, not after. Included in Athlete.

HRV WITH A REAL BASELINE
Atlas builds two baselines: a 60-day trend for long-term direction, and a 7-day trend for acute fatigue. You will see suppression before you feel it.

AUTONOMIC LOAD INDEX
A three-component daytime stress score built on your personal Smallest Worthwhile Change thresholds. Atlas watches your HRV, your heart rate, and how fast you bounce back from stress, then tells you where you stand against your own normal.

SLEEP THAT EXPLAINS PERFORMANCE
Nightly stages, efficiency, and accumulated sleep debt, shown next to your recovery score so the connection is obvious.

ILLNESS SIGNAL, QUIETLY RUNNING
Atlas watches for the pre-symptomatic pattern: elevated resting heart rate, elevated respiratory rate, and suppressed HRV, holding together for two days. Most days you will never see it. The day you do, you will know hours before you feel off.

AUTOMATIC BACKGROUND SYNC
Atlas syncs whenever new Apple Watch data arrives. Your dashboard stays current without a manual refresh.

YOUR DATA, HANDLED HONESTLY
Your health data is encrypted in transit and stored securely so Atlas can compute your scores and your long-term baselines. We never sell it or use it for advertising, and share it only with the services that run Atlas. Delete your account and it goes with you.

SUBSCRIPTION PLANS

Free includes today's readiness score, a rolling 7-day recovery view, and sleep summaries. For longer history and deeper analysis:

quotes.text:
Building Atlas, a recovery analytics platform for athletes.

The core frustration: Apple Watch collects HRV, sleep stages, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, resting HR. Apple does basically nothing useful with any of it. You get ring animations and step counts.

Atlas pulls all of that together and turns it into two scores: recovery and training readiness. The point is to actually use the signal your sensors are already collecting and ensure when you train, it matters. It’s like Whoop, but actually works.

iOS app is live (finally!). Happy to talk shop.

https://atlasbody.co/
